migrations.needle: test('4444正常首次入场双方第五PP足4所得失结果必为空；研究相同真实入口明确0得0失而正PP取得不假设无放回、种类选择不猜',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});assert.equal(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(s.fighters[0],1),0);for(const [own,foe,count,pending]of [[4,0,0,true],[0,0,0,false],[3,4,0,false],[4,1,0,true],[2,0,0,true]]){const a=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});a.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]=own;a.fighters[1].pp[key(920040)]=foe;H.entry(a);assert.equal(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(a.fighters[0],1),count);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostEntryChoice,pending);if(pending)assert.throws(()=>turn(a),/Q-N20-4444-001/);}});
migrations.insert: test('4444已答入场按魑魅魍魉依序获得失去，空白首次双方第五4PP归零，正常正PP不阻塞',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});assert.equal(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(s.fighters[0],1),0);for(const [own,foe,count]of [[4,0,4],[0,0,0],[3,4,0],[4,1,3],[2,0,2]]){const a=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});a.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]=own;a.fighters[1].pp[key(920040)]=foe;H.entry(a);assert.equal(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(a.fighters[0],1),count);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostEntryChoice,undefined);assert.doesNotThrow(()=>turn(a,920030));}});

migrations.needle: test('4444本次技能伤害范围与纯攻击不同但阈值一致时仍得确定鬼祰，跨200/300只记录待答不伪装攻击或全伤口径',()=>{const s=make(pick(29)[0],{soul:2085});timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:190});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(o),190);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),150);assert.ok(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostDamageLow);assert.ok(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostDamageHigh);});
migrations.insert: test('4444已答本次红伤190附固定150不改变200/300阈值，魍授予而魉不授，无pending',()=>{const s=make(pick(29)[0],{soul:2085});timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:190});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(o),190);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),150);assert.ok(H.E.GHOST_RULES.active(o.fighters[0],'魍',1));assert.equal(H.E.GHOST_RULES.active(o.fighters[0],'魉',1),false);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostDamageLow,undefined);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingGhostDamageHigh,undefined);});

migrations.needle: test('4444无视减伤的粉伤未知范围遇实际减伤明示拒绝，无减伤的粉伤正常、免粉仍免不当穿免',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['诅咒']=4;H.entry(s);H.op(s,29,[100],920031);timer(s,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});assert.throws(()=>turn(s,920031),/Q-N20-4444-003/);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比减伤'];assert.equal(sum(turn(s,920031),'fixed'),100);timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');assert.equal(sum(turn(s,920031),'fixed'),0);});
migrations.insert: test('4444已答忽略固定比例减伤回到100，免粉仍免不穿免',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['诅咒']=4;H.entry(s);H.op(s,29,[100],920031);timer(s,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});assert.equal(sum(turn(s,920031),'fixed'),100);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比减伤'];assert.equal(sum(turn(s,920031),'fixed'),100);timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');assert.equal(sum(turn(s,920031),'fixed'),0);});

migrations.needle: test('4444满4鬼祰的实际整招因当前后半生效时点未答而明确拒绝不污染原局，0至3完整第五仍执行各已知源分支',()=>{const s=make({moveId:38384,index:null});for(const k of H.E.GHOST_RULES.kinds)H.ghost(s,k);const before=structuredClone(s);assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-N20-4444-002/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);const q=make({moveId:38384,index:null},{hp:1000});H.ghost(q,'魑');const o=turn(q);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,3250);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),4);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)],4);});
migrations.insert: test('4444已答满4鬼祰整招结束才四杀，完整第五固定4和后续先制仍执行，0至3完整链保留',()=>{const s=make({moveId:38384,index:null},{hp:1000});for(const k of H.E.GHOST_RULES.kinds)H.ghost(s,k);const full=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(full,'fixed'),4);assert.equal(full.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.ok(full.fighters[0].effects.id984);assert.ok(full.fighters.every(f=>f.effects['四杀鬼囹']));assert.equal(full.fighters[0].soulState.pendingFourKillDomain,undefined);const q=make({moveId:38384,index:null},{hp:1000});H.ghost(q,'魑');const o=turn(q);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,3250);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),4);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)],4);});

migrations.needle: test('4444比例减伤忽略真实伤害回到无减伤基线而定额范围未知明确拒绝，四杀仍保留固有先制、魂印资源和PP药剂但禁HP药剂',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true}),b=structuredClone(s);timer(s,1,'全伤害减半');s.fighters[1].ailments['诅咒']=4;H.entry(s);assert.equal(sum(turn(s)),sum(turn(b)));timer(s,1,'伤害定额减免',{amount:20});assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-N20-4444-003/);const q=make(pick(881)[0],{aStats:{spe:1}});q.fighters[0].stages.def=-1;timer(q,0,'四杀鬼囹');assert.equal(turn(q).turns[0].first,0);const a=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true,hp:1000});for(const f of a.fighters)timer(a,f.side,'四杀鬼囹');const o=turn(a);assert.ok(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(o.fighters[0],1)>0);const hp=o.fighters[0].hp;o.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]=1;const pp=H.E.resolveTurn(o,['potion:pp',key(920041)]);assert.ok(pp.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]>1);const hh=H.E.resolveTurn(o,['potion:hp',key(920041)]);assert.equal(hh.fighters[0].hp,hp);});
migrations.insert: test('4444已答比例及定额忽略回到基线，四杀保留固有先制魂印资源和PP药剂禁HP药剂',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true}),b=structuredClone(s);timer(s,1,'全伤害减半');s.fighters[1].ailments['诅咒']=4;H.entry(s);assert.equal(sum(turn(s)),sum(turn(b)));timer(s,1,'伤害定额减免',{amount:20});assert.equal(sum(turn(s)),sum(turn(b)));const q=make(pick(881)[0],{aStats:{spe:1}});q.fighters[0].stages.def=-1;timer(q,0,'四杀鬼囹');assert.equal(turn(q).turns[0].first,0);const a=make(base,{soul:2085,omit:true,hp:1000});for(const f of a.fighters)timer(a,f.side,'四杀鬼囹');const o=turn(a);assert.ok(H.E.GHOST_RULES.count(o.fighters[0],1)>0);const hp=o.fighters[0].hp;o.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]=1;const pp=H.E.resolveTurn(o,['potion:pp',key(920041)]);assert.ok(pp.fighters[0].pp[key(38384)]>1);const hh=H.E.resolveTurn(o,['potion:hp',key(920041)]);assert.equal(hh.fighters[0].hp,hp);});
